context: P1 applies on synthesis, isolation, and parallelism. This is a review, not an experiment: no novice run, human witness, ontology mutation, HTML implementation, or release claim occurs. The exact target corpus is projects/domainspec-v2/development/comprehension-novice-test/{DEFINE.md,DESIGN.md,WORK-PACK.md,implementation-layering.md,novice-agent.md,stall-dataset.md,task-coverage-audit.md,task.md}; projects/body-war/ontology/business/{authoring/view-catalog.mjs,scripts/generate-views.mjs,tests/business-views.test.mjs,views/business.json,BUSINESS-VIEWS.md,BUSINESS-VIEWS.html,BUSINESS-JOURNEY-EXPERIMENT.html,profile.json,residue.json,receipts/validation-receipt.json}; and this working folder's STRATEGY-INVENTORY-PACKET.md. The source novice test measures ontology authoring, while the Body War surface supports reading, tracing, retelling, and locating boundaries; transfer validity must be tested rather than assumed. Learner-visible tasks, reviewer-only answer keys, audits, scoring rubrics, and run results must remain separate projection data and must not mutate ontology nodes or relations. Agent novice evidence is structural pre-test evidence only and cannot establish human comprehension. Body War remains candidate-local with authority_effect none and release_admission not-granted. The capability-bound execution route passed Dispatch Spec validation at DISPATCH-ROUTE.json sha256 5c964f0ed778108af1a6c59b22aa7d79d2f402e6cdf55e506446693df2ac8a05. Review agents are read-only; the parent persists attacks.md and findings.md after joins.
anti_bias_global: measurement validity versus semantic authority versus interface operability, followed by contamination gaming versus scope and claim falsification

groups.anti_bias: methodology (measurement-validity analysis vs formal authority analysis vs computational interface analysis)

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 may accept a learner prompt when blindness and scoring are valid, while agent 1 may reject the same prompt if it silently changes ontology meaning or authority; agent 0 exposes authority objections that do not affect measurement, while agent 1 exposes valid-looking measurements over an invalid semantic projection.

Agent 0 may reject an interface affordance as answer leakage or contamination even when agent 2 finds it accessible and usable, while agent 2 may expose a methodologically clean task that cannot be navigated, operated, or deterministically tested in the generated HTML.

Agent 1 may preserve a formally correct projection that remains unreadable or mechanically fragile, while agent 2 may prefer a progressive-disclosure or navigation aid that agent 1 identifies as semantic collapse, provenance loss, or an implementation claim.

Cite exact current files and lines, return severity plus a one-line repair, and defend any zero-finding area. Do not edit files or treat Inventory as authority. Budget about 2200 tokens.
